   gal te rtse mo ni rtogs pa mthogs la 'jog pa la 'dir sdug bsngal la chos bzod mthong la skyad ga bcu du las srdzan la skye ba'i dam shos la bshad pa myi 'thad ce na | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'broM</rs> na re rjes thob brgyud kyi thog ma run ba la chos bzod yin pa de mnyaM bzhag pas rtogs pa mtho bas nyes pa lNga de ces zer ba ni mi 'thad te | </seg></TEI>
